title.narrative: Acción política desde un enfoque territorial para la defensa ambiental y el derecho al agua

description.narrative: This year the biodiversity COP summit is to be held in the Colombian city of Cali. This is an important opportunity for advocacy and networking. ClimaLab's central objectives in relation to this conference focus on two aspects: (a) Make visible and amplify the successful experiences and lessons learned linked to the adaptation and conservation of biodiversity from the voices of the communities with which the organization works, thus promoting socio-environmental sustainability at local, national and global level and (b) Articulating efforts with allied organizations to promote discussion and impact on decision-making, mainly associated with the connection between biodiversity and climate, integrating approaches such as gender justice, generational succession, ancestrality and peacebuilding. At the same time there is an immediate need to respond to the environmental crisis caused by recent wildfires in the Colombian peatlands (as a result of the El Niño phenomenon), which has affected communities' access to their right to water (due to damage to community aqueducts). Therefore, a second objective of this project will be to support in the repair of these aqueducts.
